We believe art should be accessible to everyone.

Art is for everyone, not just trained artists or people who consider themselves creative. We make our experiences welcoming, accessible and thoughtfully priced, without compromising on quality.

It is about creating spaces where people can unwind, explore their creativity, connect with others, and enjoy the simple pleasure of making something by hand.

Thoughtful pricing

Customised formats designed around each organisation’s requirements and budget.

Creative experiences, backed by thoughtful execution.

We bring the workshop to you: a guided, on-site experience shaped around your team and your Diwali plans. Our experience spans events and workshops at Tier 1 colleges, corporate settings, individual workshops, collaborations and community-led experiences.

A successful workshop needs more than a good idea. It needs careful planning, engaging facilitation and smooth on-ground execution. Depending on the agreed package, we can support:

  • Workshop planning and customisation
  • Craft materials and participant supplies
  • On-ground setup and execution
  • Step-by-step artistic guidance
  • Engaging activities and team-building moments
  • A welcoming, inclusive atmosphere
  • Coordination tailored to the venue and group size

From the first creative idea to the final handmade piece, we help bring the experience to life.
